Copy a selection with its highlights, fixes from Obsidian's plugin review, and the server on a release page of its own. (0.6.4 was tagged but never published; this release carries its changes.)

## What changed since 0.6.3

- **Copy with Augmented View highlights.** Select text in a note with a colour code, right-click and choose *Copy with Augmented View highlights* (or run the command *Copy selection with highlights*). The selection goes to the clipboard as Markdown, with each coloured sentence wrapped in a marker, `~={#FFD2D2, Claims}…=~`, or, if you prefer, `<mark data-colour="#FFD2D2" data-category="Claims">…</mark>`; phrase colours can be included too. The colours are the ones the editor shows (the note's colour code, the sensitivity, the rules); where the selection cuts a sentence, the marker covers the selected part only, and colours not computed yet are computed first. The markers keep code, maths, links, footnotes, lists, tables and block ids intact. The note is never changed and nothing is written but the clipboard. The menu item can be hidden in Settings → Augmented View → Copy with highlights. See [Copying with highlights](https://github.com/Gameboard-dev/obsidian-augmented-view/blob/main/docs/colour-codes.md#copying-with-highlights).
- **Styles:** the floating key folds without `!important` in the stylesheet (the plugin clears and restores the height you gave it), the settings' contents column uses `gap`, and marks use the unprefixed `box-decoration-break`.
- **Same marks, shared code:** the code that draws the marks as paragraphs come into view, in the editor and in Reading view, and the copy with highlights now live in a shared library crate; nothing visible changes and it is no slower.
- **The server has its own release page.** This release carries only the plugin's files, `main.js`, `manifest.json` and `styles.css`, as Obsidian asks. The server programs, their checksums and licence files are on [server-0.6.2](https://github.com/Gameboard-dev/obsidian-augmented-view/releases/tag/server-0.6.2); the server is unchanged since 0.6.2, so an installed one needs nothing.

## Requirements and installation

As in 0.6.2: Obsidian 1.8.7 or later, desktop only, and the model server for your computer. Step by step: [Installation](https://github.com/Gameboard-dev/obsidian-augmented-view/blob/main/docs/installation.md).
